mapping.summary: Manages employee leave and time-off entitlements
claims: My Time Off Calendar to view balances and submit requests
Team calendar of colleagues' planned time off
Entitlement models: fixed, weekly, monthly, annual, anniversary, multi-year
Future requests account for projected earnings
Work and holiday calendars per employee, shifts or region
Approval workflows with manager and temporary delegation
Minimum staffing requirements and blackout periods
HR can file requests for employees who do not use BC
Balance adjustments via Time Off Journal with ledger audit trail
Requester, Approver and HR permission sets
Optional integration with standard Employee Absence
Automated entitlement processing via Job Queue
